hero.title: STUDY MBBS IN EGYPT
hero.subtitle: Explore MBBS Opportunities in Egypt 2026–2027. Century-old medical heritage, massive tertiary hospitals, and globally respected faculties.

overview: Egypt has emerged as a premier destination for Indian medical aspirants seeking top-tier clinical exposure. Historic government universities in Cairo and Alexandria manage enormous hospital networks with thousands of beds, enabling students to gain extensive practical bedside experience.

faq.question: Is MBBS in Egypt valid for Indian students?
faq.answer: Yes, MBBS degrees from NMC/WHO-recognized Egyptian universities are valid in India. Graduates must qualify NExT/FMGE to practice in India.

faq.question: What is the total cost of MBBS in Egypt?
faq.answer: The complete package (tuition + hostel + food) usually ranges from ₹30 lakh to ₹45 lakh for the full 6-year course.

faq.question: Is NEET required for MBBS in Egypt?
faq.answer: Yes, NEET qualification is compulsory for all Indian students as per NMC guidelines.

faq.question: What is the duration of MBBS in Egypt?
faq.answer: The MBBS course duration is 6 years (5 years of academic study + 1 year of compulsory rotatory internship).
